answer: Proof of Personhood filters Sybil agents by anchoring identity to unique biometric entropy. This kernel of verification prevents an ocean of fake nodes from saturating the network. Like water shaping a karst landscape, attackers must erode high-friction verification thresholds. Since every false identity requires a distinct physical manifestation, the cost to scale a botnet becomes economically prohibitive, forcing attackers to bypass the consensus via extreme capital expenditure.
